Kazakhstan.assumption: The rest of the solar/non-solar programme is represented as wind for conversion. Named post-2025 projects are deducted by technology. Accelerated continues after 2035 at long-window historical net MW/year. High reaches the programme in 2033 (auction horizon) and continues from 2036 at the 2026–2035 policy pace by technology.

Kyrgyzstan.assumption: Accelerated includes Kazarman at 3.75 TWh/year (published lower design figure). High adds Kokomeren stages at their planning dates with half-year output in commissioning years, and replaces the BAU Kambarata dates with the alternative World Bank 2035 start and an author ramp through 2037.

Tajikistan.assumption: The 500 MW already in BAU is part of the 1500 MW plan. High attains 10% non-hydro renewable share of domestic generation in 2050, adapting the diversification benchmark to the model's power-generation boundary. Nonrenewable generation is held at the IRENA 2024 level for that denominator; all incremental non-hydro output is modelled as solar-equivalent.

Turkmenistan.assumption: Illustrative solar replication only. BAU retains the original 300 MW project. Accelerated adds one equivalent block, High four. Full-year dates and replication cadence are author assumptions; blocks receive half output in the preceding commissioning year.

Uzbekistan.assumption: Accelerated uses long-window IRENA solar and wind net MW/year after 2026, net of named additions through 2050. High reaches the official 2030 share using the stated minimum gross generation anchor. Its added annual service above Accelerated is retained thereafter; subsequent growth follows the same long-window pace as Accelerated. No external 2050 point is imposed. The 2030 policy gap is expressed as implied additional solar and wind MW with weights proportional to the long-window net capacity rates. The announced 2200 MW tender is a scale comparator, with overlap and commissioning unverified.
Uzbekistan.capacity_mix_basis: Shares of long-window net solar and wind MW per year in IRENA; used only for the implied capacity bridge, not as a verified project mix.
